cards.ex: The company managed to weather the storm of the financial crisis.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya moliyaviy inqirozning qiyinchiliklarini yengib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Og'ir vaziyatdan muvaffaqiyatli o'tib ketish, yomon davrni boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: There's a worrying trend of increasing obesity in young children.
cards.exUz: Yosh bolalar orasida semizlikning ortib borayotgan xavotirli tendentsiyasi kuzatilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavotirga soladigan, yomonlashayotgan holat yoki o'zgarish.

cards.ex: After surgery and rehab, he made a clean break from his addiction.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan va reabilitatsiyadan so'ng, u o'zining giyohvandlikdan butunlay tuzaldi.
cards.uzDef: Kasalikdan butunlay tuzalib ketish, hech qanday asoratlarsiz sog'ayish.

cards.ex: For the patient in the emergency room, it was a matter of life and death.
cards.exUz: Tez yordam xonasidagi bemor uchun bu hayot-mamot masalasi edi.
cards.term: a matter of life and death
cards.uzDef: Juda jiddiy vaziyat, unda hayot xavf ostida bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: We don't know what's causing his illness, so this treatment is a shot in the dark.
cards.exUz: Biz uning kasalligiga nima sabab bo'layotganini bilmaymiz, shuning uchun bu davolash taxminiy urinishdir.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun aniq ma'lumotlarsiz qilingan taxminiy harakat.

cards.ex: The stress of the job began to take its toll on his health.
cards.exUz: Ishning stressi uning sog'lig'iga o'z ta'sirini ko'rsata boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatish, zarar yetkazish.

cards.ex: His condition took a turn for the worse overnight.
cards.exUz: Uning ahvoli bir kechada yomon tomonga o'zgardi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning birdan yomonlashishi, kasallikning og'irlashishi.

cards.ex: The surgery was successful, so he's finally in the clear.
cards.exUz: Operatsiya muvaffaqiyatli o'tdi, shuning uchun u nihoyat xavfdan qutuldi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyat tugadi, xavf yo'q.

cards.ex: The lack of sleep creates a vicious cycle of stress and anxiety.
cards.exUz: Uyqusizlik stress va tashvishning aylanma jarayonini yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z-o'zini kuchaytiruvchi salbiy holat, muammoni yechish qiyin.

cards.ex: She's down with the flu, so she can't come to the party.
cards.exUz: U gripp bilan kasal, shuning uchun u ziyofatga kelolmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kasal bo'lib qolish, kasallikni yuqtirib olish (odatda yengil kasallik).

cards.ex: The new treatment offers a ray of hope for patients with this disease.
cards.exUz: Yangi davolash usuli ushbu kasallik bilan kasallangan bemorlar uchun umid nurini taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, ammo muhim umid belgisi.

cards.ex: He's fighting a losing battle against his addiction.
cards.exUz: U giyohvandlikka qarshi foydasiz kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish imkoni bo'lmagan narsaga qarshi kurashish.

cards.ex: Eating healthy foods can help ward off illness.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom ovqatlar iste'mol qilish kasalliklarning oldini olishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yomon narsaning sodir bo'lishining oldini olish.

cards.ex: After the illness, he was a shadow of his former self.
cards.exUz: Kasallikdan so'ng, u sobiq o'zining soyasi edi.
cards.term: a shadow of your former self
cards.uzDef: Avvalgidek emas, kasallik yoki qiyinchilikdan keyin kuchsizlashgan holat.

cards.ex: The doctor's diagnosis gave him a dose of reality about his lifestyle.
cards.exUz: Shifokorning tashxisi unga o'z turmush tarzi haqida haqiqat zarbasini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning haqiqiy, ko'pincha yoqimsiz tomonini tushunish.

cards.ex: The patient seemed to be recovering, but then developed complications from pneumonia.
cards.exUz: Bemor tuzalayotgandek edi, lekin keyin pnevmoniyadan asoratlar paydo bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik tufayli qo'shimcha muammolar kelib chiqishi.

cards.ex: She manages her chronic condition with diet and exercise.
cards.exUz: U surunkali kasalligini parhez va mashqlar bilan nazorat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etadigan, davolash qiyin kasallik.

cards.ex: The insurance company denied his claim because of a pre-existing condition.
cards.exUz: Sug'urta kompaniyasi uning da'vosini oldindan mavjud bo'lgan kasalligi sababli rad etdi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'liq sug'urtasi boshlanishidan oldin mavjud bo'lgan kasallik.

cards.ex: For a few days after the surgery, it was touch and go.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan keyin bir necha kun davomida ahvol juda xavfli edi.
cards.uzDef: Ahvol juda og'ir, o'lim xavfi bor.

cards.ex: The treatment seemed to work, but now we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Davolash yordam berganga o'xshadi, lekin endi biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi holatga qaytish, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: It was a tough time, but he eventually came out of it stronger.
cards.exUz: Bu og'ir vaqt edi, lekin u oxir-oqibat undan kuchliroq bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan, kasallikdan tuzalish.

cards.ex: The pain medication should kick in within half an hour.
cards.exUz: Og'riq qoldiruvchi dori yarim soat ichida ta'sir ko'rsatishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Dori yoki davolashning ta'sirini boshlashi.

cards.ex: After a week in the hospital, he's finally on the upswing.
cards.exUz: Kasalxonada bir hafta yotgandan so'ng, u nihoyat yaxshilanish sari ketmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ahvolning yaxshilanishi, tuzalish jarayoni.

cards.ex: The doctor said he's out of the woods now, but still needs rest.
cards.exUz: Shifokor uning xavfdan xalos bo'lganini, lekin hali ham dam olishi kerakligini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyat tugadi, endi xavotirga o'rin yo'q.

cards.ex: After the surgery, his energy levels were at a low ebb.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan keyin uning energiya darajasi eng past nuqtada edi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'liqning yoki kayfiyatning eng yomon holati.

cards.ex: After the flu, I felt as weak as a kitten.
cards.exUz: Grippdan keyin men mushukchadek zaif his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Juda zaif, kuchsiz.

cards.ex: He fell seriously ill while traveling abroad.
cards.exUz: U chet elda sayohat qilayotganda qattiq kasal bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy kasallikka chalinish, og'ir ahvolga tushish.

cards.ex: He tried to shrug off the pain, but it was too intense.
cards.exUz: U og'riqni e'tibor bermaslikka harakat qildi, lekin u juda kuchli edi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikni yoki og'riqni ahamiyatsiz deb hisoblash.

cards.ex: Her arthritis tends to flare up in cold weather.
cards.exUz: Uning artriti sovuq havoda zo'rayib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Surunkali kasallik alomatlarining kutilmaganda kuchayishi.

cards.ex: The news was a heavy dose of reality for him.
cards.exUz: Bu yangiliklar u uchun haqiqatning kuchli ta'siri edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir kuchli va salbiy ta'siri.
